headline: Axita Cotton files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Formal AGM voting results now public
summary: Axita Cotton Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also disclosed the final voting results to the National Stock Exchange. This filing confirms the completion of the mandatory post-AGM compliance process.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
